# hitachi_vsp_snapshot_group (Data Source)

Datasource to show snapshots (Thin Image pairs) in snapshot groups in Hitachi VSP storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
#
# Hitachi VSP Snapshot Group Data Retrieval
#
# This data source retrieves detailed configuration and status information for a 
# specific Hitachi Thin Image (TI) or Thin Image Advanced (TIA) Snapshot Group.
#
# A Snapshot Group organizes multiple snapshot pairs into a single consistency unit, 
# ensuring that all member volumes are captured at the exact same point-in-time.
#

#####################
data "hitachi_vsp_snapshot_group" "snapshotgroup" {
  serial              = 12345
  snapshot_group_name = "snapshotgroupname"
}

# Returns the detailed attributes of the specified group, including member pair statuses.
output "snapshot_group" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot_group.snapshotgroup.snapshot_group
}

# Returns the number of P-VOL/S-VOL pairs currently belonging to this group.
output "snapshot_count" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot_group.snapshotgroup.snapshot_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `serial` (Number) Serial number of the storage system.

### Optional

- `snapshot_group_name` (String) Filter by a specific snapshot group name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `snapshot_count` (Number) Number of snapshot pairs returned.
- `snapshot_group` (Block List) List of snapshot groups matching the criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--snapshot_group))

<a id="nestedblock--snapshot_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshot_group`

Read-Only:

- `snapshot_group_id` (String) The unique ID of the snapshot group.
- `snapshot_group_name` (String) The name of the snapshot group.
- `snapshots` (Block List) Detailed list of snapshot pairs within this group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--snapshot_group--snapshots))

<a id="nestedblock--snapshot_group--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshot_group.snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `can_cascade` (Boolean) True if the pair can be a cascaded pair.
- `concordance_rate` (Number) Concordance rate between P-VOL and S-VOL.
- `is_clone` (Boolean) True if the pair has the clone attribute.
- `is_consistency_group` (Boolean) True if pair is created in CTG mode.
- `is_redirect_on_write` (Boolean) True if the pair is Thin Image Advanced.
- `is_virtual_clone_parent_volume` (Boolean) True if the volume has the vClone Parent attribute. For VSP One B20/B85 only.
- `is_virtual_clone_volume` (Boolean) True if the volume has the vClone attribute or vClone Parent attribute. For VSP One B20/B85 only
- `is_written_in_svol` (Boolean) True if data was written to the S-VOL when status was PSUS/PFUS.
- `mirror_unit_id` (Number) MU number of the P-VOL.
- `primary_or_secondary` (String) Attribute of the LDEV (P-VOL or S-VOL).
- `progress_rate` (Number) Progress of processing (%).
- `pvol_ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number of the Primary Volume (P-VOL).
- `pvol_ldev_id_hex` (String) P-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format
- `pvol_processing_status` (String) Processing status of the P-VOL pair (E: In Progress, N: Not In Progress).
- `retention_period_hours` (Number) The remaining period for which snapshot data of the Thin Image Advanced pair is retained (in hours) if set.
- `snapshot_data_read_only` (Boolean) True if the snapshot data has the read-only attribute.
- `snapshot_group_name` (String) Name of the snapshot group.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Identifier in the format 'pvolLdevId,muNumber'.
- `snapshot_pool_id` (Number) ID of the pool where snapshot data is created.
- `split_time` (String) Timestamp when snapshot data was created.
- `status` (String) Current pair status.
- `svol_ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number of the Secondary Volume (S-VOL).
- `svol_ldev_id_hex` (String) S-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format
- `svol_processing_status` (String) Processing status of the S-VOL pair (E: In Progress, N: Not In Progress).
